page.metaTitle: Concert Ticket & Tour Date Alerts | WebMonitor.fyi
page.metaDescription: Get email alerts on concert ticket releases, tour date announcements, and ticket-resale pricing on Ticketmaster, StubHub, and direct artist sites — checks as often as every 30 minutes.
page.h1: Concert ticket release and tour date alerts
page.subtitle: Track Ticketmaster pre-sales, artist tour pages, and resale platforms for ticket availability and price changes.
page.intro: Fans tracking specific artists want to hear quickly when tour dates announce and tickets release. WebMonitor.fyi monitors artist tour pages, Ticketmaster artist pages, and resale platforms (StubHub, SeatGeek) for new dates and ticket-availability changes, with checks as often as every 30 minutes.

setup.title: Add the artist's tour page
setup.body: Most artists maintain a tour page on their official site. That's the first place tour dates announce.

setup.title: Add the Ticketmaster artist page
setup.body: Catches Ticketmaster pre-sale activations and on-sale times.

setup.title: Add resale platform pages for sold-out shows
setup.body: StubHub and SeatGeek pages for sold-out shows let you track resale prices and catch drops.

setup.title: Slack alerts for high-stakes drops
setup.body: Major tour on-sales sell out in minutes. A Slack incoming webhook puts the alert in a channel you're already watching.

examples: Fans tracking favorite artists for tour announcements
Travel planners coordinating tickets with travel arrangements
Corporate ticket buyers tracking premium-seat availability
page.limits: Ticket monitoring catches what the platform publishes publicly. Verified-fan pre-sales and Spotify-fan-club codes operate inside authenticated systems — those still require manual sign-up. WebMonitor catches the on-sale activation; getting through the queue is separate.

faq.a: On a 30-minute interval (Pro), alerts arrive within about 30 minutes of the page update. For Ticketmaster on-sales that sell out in literally minutes, that may not be fast enough — the alert tells you it's on sale, but the on-sale itself may be over by the time you click through.

faq.q: Can I track multiple artists at once?
faq.a: Yes. One monitor per artist tour page — plans include up to 5 monitors on Pro.

faq.q: Does resale-price tracking work on StubHub?
faq.a: Yes. The StubHub event page is a monitor URL. Set the criterion "alert me when prices drop below $X" for price-drop hunting.
